title: Time cards only show the active lunch wave
summary: The Schedule Type Editor's period time cards for 3rd/7th period and Lunch were always showing both a 1st Lunch and 2nd Lunch time row, even though a slot like A_LUNCH only ever applies to whichever lunch wave A Day is actually set to -- now only that one row shows. The other wave's time is still saved underneath, so switching the lunch-wave setting later reveals it again instead of losing it.
